verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a first-party organization plugin for managing an organization's members and teams, with roles and permissions. The homepage advertises "Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control," and a community user independently reports getting organizations and multi-tenant capabilities from the included plugins without writing special code. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the invitation flow (it appears only in a marketing tagline), and specifics of the membership APIs/schema in the evidence.
